_comment: Hand-picked reading list behind /newsletters/. Lives here rather than in build-pages.mjs so the page date tracks when the list actually changed, not when the builder was last edited.
updated_note: the page stamps itself from this file's last commit

newsletters.name: neobankbeat
newsletters.author: Francesco Andreoli
newsletters.blurb: The newsletter behind this site: what changed in the dataset, new entrants, and the monthly State of Neobanks report.

newsletters.name: Fintech Brainfood
newsletters.author: Simon Taylor
newsletters.blurb: The industry’s Sunday read — one big rant, four fintech companies that matter, and the things to know this week.

newsletters.name: Fintech Takes
newsletters.author: Alex Johnson
newsletters.blurb: Sharp long-form analysis of US fintech: bank–fintech partnerships, credit, regulation, and why things actually happen.

newsletters.name: This Week in Fintech
newsletters.author: Nik Milanović
newsletters.blurb: The global funding and news roundup, with dedicated regional editions for LatAm, Africa, Asia and Europe.

newsletters.name: Fintech Business Weekly
newsletters.author: Jason Mikula
newsletters.blurb: The investigative one: banking-as-a-service, sponsor banks, consent orders and enforcement — often breaking the story.

newsletters.name: Net Interest
newsletters.author: Marc Rubinstein
newsletters.blurb: A former hedge-fund manager on the economics of financial firms — the deepest “how banks actually make money” essays anywhere.

newsletters.name: Fintech Blueprint
newsletters.author: Lex Sokolin
newsletters.blurb: Where fintech meets digital assets and AI — strategy essays and founder interviews from a former ConsenSys CFO.

newsletters.name: Popular Fintech
newsletters.author: Jevgenijs Kazanins
newsletters.blurb: Data-heavy breakdowns of public fintech and neobank earnings — the numbers behind Nubank, SoFi, Revolut and friends.

newsletters.name: Fintech Wrap Up
newsletters.author: Sam Boboev
newsletters.blurb: Fintech explained in diagrams — infographic-first summaries of business models, products and partnerships.

newsletters.name: WhiteSight
newsletters.author: research team
newsletters.blurb: Visual fintech research: embedded finance, BaaS and digital-bank strategy mapped into frameworks and charts.
